verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test environment, test-mode API keys, or simulated sending that is kept separate from production. Pods (per-customer data isolation) and scoped API keys are adjacent multi-tenancy and permission controls, not a sandbox. The free tier is a pricing plan, not an isolated test environment. One community commenter only urged the vendor to build local dev/testing infrastructure, which does not show that it exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
